variant: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater / Groznyj Grad Shagohod; not a bipedal Metal Gear

references.role: Official Konami MGS3 history identifying Groznyj Grad and the rocket-engine-equipped Shagohod

prompts.core: Create an original fan-made pixel-art production sprite board of the Shagohod from Metal Gear Solid 3 for side-view 2D gameplay. It must remain a long, low, olive-drab experimental Cold War nuclear delivery vehicle: huge upper rocket body, rear tracked/rocket propulsion block, armored central hull, and two prominent forward auger screws. It is not a biped, not REX, RAY, Sahelanthropus, a normal tank or a generic sci-fi rover. Fixed orthographic side view facing screen right in all cells. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows with sixteen distinct authored poses: idle, movement, charge/rocket-boost preparation and attack. Flat pure #FF00FF magenta background and exactly five straight cyan guides vertically and horizontally including the outside borders. Leave safe empty magenta clearance around every machine and effect. No text, logo, UI, scenery, watermark or official-art extraction.
prompts.special: Create the matching original fan-made Shagohod special board, preserving the exact same right-facing olive rocket-tank identity, augers, tracks, hull proportions and scale. Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows: recover, restrained hit reactions, progressive grounded destruction/death, and sensor scan. Flat #FF00FF, exactly five cyan guides on each axis including borders, full machine contained in every cell, no text, logo, UI, scenery, watermark or unrelated mech.
prompts.marginCorrectionCore: Precision edit the supplied 4x4 Shagohod core board. Preserve identity, grid, background and the same 16 actions. Uniformly reduce each complete machine and all exhaust, smoke, dust, sparks and projectiles to about 82 percent, preserving the ground baseline and leaving at least 24 source pixels of pure magenta from every guide and edge, especially the row-three charge exhaust.
prompts.marginCorrectionSpecial: Precision edit the supplied 4x4 Shagohod special board. Preserve identity, grid, background and the same 16 recover, hit, death and scan actions. Uniformly reduce every machine and all smoke, debris, dust, sparks and scan effects to about 82 percent, preserving the ground baseline and leaving at least 24 source pixels of pure magenta from every guide and edge.

technicalGuideNormalization: After visual approval, only long cyan guide bands were normalized to exact quarter-cell positions; no sprite or effect occupied those safety strips and no authored pose pixels were altered.
